goal: Prove that a vault/accountant/connector uses net external equity for backing, surplus, solvency, or yield gates rather than gross supplied/collateral balances.
setup_requirements: test harness can mock or simulate the external precompile/API/account reader
downstream gate such as totalBackingSigned, surplus, totalAssets, collateral ratio, settle, mint, withdraw, or liquidation is reachable
unit conversion helpers for asset and liability fields are visible or controllable
minimal_state: local protocol has nonzero liabilities or token supply that requires external backing
external account reports a positive supplied/collateral field
the same external account reports borrow/debt/liability greater than or equal to the supplied/collateral value
a value-moving gate consumes the adapter/accountant output
attacker_actions: seed or mock supplied/collateral balance as positive
seed or mock borrow/debt liability larger than supplied balance
call the local view that computes backing/surplus/solvency and compare gross-only result to expected net equity
call the downstream settlement/mint/withdraw/liquidation path and verify whether the gate incorrectly passes
assertions: net-equity-aware backing is supplied_value - borrow_liability after matching units and prices
surplus/distributable/solvency is non-positive when borrow liabilities exceed supplied assets
the downstream value-moving gate reverts or refuses distribution under net-negative external state
a vulnerable implementation reports positive backing or accepts settlement from the same state
common_failures: mocking only the asset-side field and never modeling the sibling borrow/debt field
proving a bad Operator parameter instead of the contract gate accepting an omitted-liability state
mixing L1/L2 or token decimal domains so the debt subtraction comparison is meaningless
stopping at a view mismatch without driving a value-moving gate or protocol-function impact
notes: Added after Monetrix M-01. Use this recipe whenever an external PM/lending/strategy account contributes to total backing, TVL, surplus, or solvency.
